title: Real class status drives everything.
summary: The CANONICAL system starts from what actually happened in class, not what the calendar says should have happened. Every session brief, artifact, and export traces back to real student status.

workflow.title: Record real class status
workflow.text: Rough classflow notes capture what was completed, what remains, what is blocked, and what evidence needs to be captured.

workflow.title: Build a Session Brief
workflow.text: The helper turns rough notes into a structured Session Brief: completed, remaining, blocked, student learning, evidence, and next step.

workflow.title: Separate the rails
workflow.text: AYA/CTS outputs stay student and institution safe. PRISM keeps facilitator intelligence private or curated.

workflow.title: Produce the packet
workflow.text: Daily plans, student guides, QC cards, classroom copy, slide outlines, and filing plans are generated from the brief.

workflow.title: Return to CANONICAL
workflow.text: Approved artifacts point back to CANONICAL packages. The portal mirrors records without replacing the file spine.

rails: AYA / CTS — Classroom-safe delivery materials for student and institution use
PRISM — Private facilitator intelligence, kept internal by default
CTS / RCS — Public or open-source output layer for approved sharing
Mixed — Dual-rail artifacts explicitly tagged for combined use
